# Pro-GenAI — Full Project and Documentation Link Index

> Plain-text, AI-readable companion to https://pro-genai.github.io/. 23 public repository links and 177 distinct project website URLs. Snapshot: 2026-11-20. All links below are also available in HTML on the main index page.

## ReaTerm

A Rust-based read-only terminal with Python, TypeScript, and MCP integrations for bounded file inspection in agent workflows; an experimental tool, not an audited security boundary.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/ReaTerm)
- [Official project website](https://reaterm.pro-genai.com/)

Source sitemap: https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/ReaTerm/blob/main/docs/website/sitemap.xml (SHA 8103687dc1b79087f3e626d644a0409212c76c4f)

## OpenBox Agent-RT SDK (TS)

A TypeScript integration between Agent-RT and OpenBox with an enforcing governance entry point and separate observability helpers.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/openbox-agentrt-sdk-ts)


## OpenBox Agent-RT SDK (Python)

A Python adapter for governing Agent-RT model and tool calls with inline policy checks, telemetry, and optional human approvals.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/openbox-agentrt-sdk-python)


## Safe-LLM

Fine-tuning experiments on the HarmActions dataset that train small language models to avoid harmful tool calls and report unsafe requests.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Safe-LLM)


## Generative AI Project Template

A Python starter template with FastAPI chat endpoints, optional RAG utilities, tests, and Docker deployment examples.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/gen-ai-project-template)


## A2A Agent Action Guard

An Agent-to-Agent evaluation setup measuring whether agents attempt harmful tool actions when given adversarial tasks.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/A2A-Agent-Action-Guard)


## Memory Transformer

Experimental PyTorch memory modules using trainable slots to store and retrieve text without a separate vector database.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Memory-Transformer)


## Guarded MCP Proxy

An MCP transport proxy connecting stdio with HTTP or SSE modes while incorporating an action-classifier guard layer.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/mcp-proxy-guarded)


## Smart Prompt Eval

An evaluation framework for testing robustness to language errors, multilingual prompts, role changes, and harmful prompt variations.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Smart-Prompt-Eval)


## iRAT

A research-oriented reasoning pipeline combining replanning, controlled retrieval, and chain evaluation, not intended for production deployment.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/iRAT)


## Agent-RT

A Python and TypeScript runtime for agents, covering tools, streaming, permissions, approvals, memory, checkpoints, and observability.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-RT)
- [Official project website](https://agent-rt.pro-genai.com/)

## Agent Action Guard

A lightweight framework that classifies and blocks harmful AI agent actions before they cause harm.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard)
- [Official project website](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/)
- [Documentation overview](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/docs/)
- [Research articles and guides](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/blog/)
- [Blog · Unsafe Ai Agent Actions](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/blog/unsafe-ai-agent-actions/)
- [Blog · Best Ai Agent Frameworks 2026](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/blog/best-ai-agent-frameworks-2026/)
- [Blog · Stop Prompt Injection](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/blog/stop-prompt-injection/)
- [Blog · Secure Mcp Tool Calls](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/blog/secure-mcp-tool-calls/)
- [Privacy](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/terms/)

Source sitemap: https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard/blob/main/docs/website/sitemap.xml (SHA e10fbfa3fd15515951705fd5f30efba5ac4edae3)


## Index-RAG

A retrieval approach that stores text locations alongside vector data to improve source tracking and citation accuracy.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Index-RAG)


## ToolSEE

A tool search and selection approach designed to help agents choose relevant tools from large catalogs.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Tool-SEE)


## Reasoning Router

A multi-strategy reasoning framework using LangGraph to select approaches for multi-step problem solving.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Reasoning-Router)


## FAQ-RAG

A citation-aware RAG approach that transforms documents into structured, grounded FAQ entries for retrieval.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/FAQ-RAG)


## Gen-UI-Lang

A compact, LLM-friendly UI language that can render to targets including HTML, React JSX, and Gradio.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Gen-UI-Lang)


## Large Supervisor Models

An approach to monitoring and interrupting unsafe LLM output during generation, instead of filtering only afterward.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Large-Supervisor-Models)


## Data Classifier

A rule-based classifier for labeling LLM training or fine-tuning data, including sensitive, unsafe, and spam-like content.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/DataClassifier)


## S3Q Reasoning

A prompt-level framework that exposes knowledge, missing information, and assumptions for more auditable answers.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/S3Q-Reasoning)


## AutoWatcher

An LLM-assisted security alert concept combining detection systems and context-aware threat assessment.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/AutoWatcher)


## Small Specialist Models

Research into specialized models aimed at reducing model cost and latency through focused capabilities.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Small-Specialist-Models)
